title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:

**Objective of the WHO Programme/Department:**

The overall objective of the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit in Department of HSD is to support the Member States to improve health for everyone, everywhere by accelerating the development and adoption of appropriate, accessible, affordable, scalable and sustainable person-centric digital health & AI solutions to prevent, detect and respond to epidemics and pandemics, developing infrastructure and applications that enable countries to use health data to promote health and well-being, and to achieve the health-related Sustainable Development Goals. WHO-SEARO is harnessing the power of digital technologies and health innovation to accelerate global attainment of health and the well-being.

Translating latest data, research, and evidence into action: this means promoting standards for interoperability and data sharing and supporting implementation of digital solutions that contribute to informed decision making. Enhancing knowledge through scientific communities of practice: enabled by new technologies and no longer limited by the need for physical meetings or hard copy peer review journals, WHO brings together top expert voices around topics of clinical and public health significance. Systematically assessing and linking country needs with supply of innovations. WHO-SEARO takes a proactive, systematic approach to identify, promote, co-develop, and scale innovations that are based on country needs of the South East Asia Region. Also, to recognize the successful digital health & AI initiatives and the urgent need to address the major impediments faced by least-developed countries of the region through implementing digital health technologies, to promote the appropriate use of digital technologies for health and to strengthen health systems by introducing digital technologies.

**Objective of JPP:**

The JPP will support the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit at WHO-SEARO in strengthening the responsible development, evaluation, implementation and scale-up of artificial intelligence for health ecosystem across the South-East Asia Region.

The JPP will provide specialized technical support to Member States across the AI lifecycle, including identification and prioritization of health-system problems suitable for AI applications; assessment of data readiness and technical requirements; development and review of AI approaches; validation and evaluation of AI-enabled technologies/programs; deployment and integration within health systems; and post-deployment monitoring and scale-up.

The JPP will also contribute to regional and country-level work on AI governance, safety, ethics, equity, technical standards, technology assessment, capacity building and evidence generation, helping Member States translate advances in AI into safe, effective, equitable and context-appropriate health applications.

**Supervisor:**

First Level: Dr Karthik Adapa, RA-DH

Second Level : Mr Manoj Jhalani, Director-HSD

**Terms of reference**

Under the overall guidance of the **Director, Department of Health Systems Development (HSD)** and the direct supervision of the **Regional Adviser, Digital Health**, the JPP will provide support in the following areas:

* Provide technical support to WHO-SEARO and Member States on AI enabled solutions, strategies and implementation.
* Support the Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI) implementation, operationalization, developing State AI Readiness Index, and AI health work related to SAHI.
* Support the technical assessment, validation, evaluation of AI-enabled health technologies/programs.
* Support Member States in assessing AI readiness, including data availability, quality, representativeness, infrastructure, computational requirements, interoperability, workforce capacity and institutional readiness.
* Support the development and application of AI evaluation frameworks and methodologies
* Contribute to AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
* Support development of conceptual frameworks, technical guidance, strategic plans, policy proposals, technical specifications, reports and knowledge products related to AI in health.
* Undertake evidence reviews, technical analyses and horizon scanning on emerging AI technologies and their potential applications, risks and implications for health systems.
* Support technical implementation and integration of AI applications within existing digital health ecosystems, including consideration of interoperability, APIs, data standards, digital public infrastructure and existing health-information systems.
* Support Member States in developing technical and institutional capacity for AI in health, including technical workshops, training programmes, and practical capacity-building activities.
* Facilitate technical engagement with Ministries of Health, WHO Country Offices, academic and research institutions, technology developers, regulatory institutions, development partners and other stakeholders involved in AI development, evaluation and implementation.
* Support documentation and dissemination of AI implementation experiences, evaluations, lessons and good practices across the South-East Asia Region.
* Undertake other related technical activities assigned by the Regional Adviser, Digital Health, in alignment with WHO-SEARO priorities.

**Education:**

**Essential:** Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Computational Sciences, or another closely related technical discipline relevant to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or data science.

**Desirable:** Masters/PhD strongly recommended in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Public Health, or a related field, with demonstrated interdisciplinary education and/or experience at the intersection of health and technology development/application.

Additional academic training, certification or demonstrated technical expertise in health law, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, health informatics, biomedical data science, AI evaluation or responsible AI would be an asset.

**Experience:**

Essential: At least two years of experience working on digital health, artificial intelligence, or machine-learning projects, including direct experience in AI for health involving the development, testing, validation, deployment, evaluation, or scale-up of AI-enabled health technologies.

Desirable:

* Experience in AI technology assessment, product development, clinical or public-health AI evaluation, AI safety, health informatics or digital health architecture.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with governments, Ministries of Health, academic and research institutions, technology developers, NGOs, development partners and/or global funders, particularly in low- and middle-income countries or the Global South.
* Relevant experience working with UN agencies, in particular WHO.
* Knowledge of any/multiple SEA Regional languages is an asset.

**Age:**Below 35 years

This Vacancy Notice is only applicable to nationals of South-East Asia Region Member States i.e., Bangladesh, Bhutan, DPR Korea, India, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Timor-Leste

**Skills required for the assignment:**

Minimum:

* Proficiency in spoken and written English;
* Strong technical understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science and statistical modelling.
* Deep understanding on DPIs, DPI-Health, Reference Architecture
* Deep understanding of the AI development lifecycle
* Ability to critically assess and evaluate AI models and products
* Deep understanding of SAHI, National AI health strategies globally
* Understanding of health data, health information systems and the technical considerations involved in integrating AI into digital health environments.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into recommendations for policymakers, health-system leaders and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, scientific writing and technical communication skills.
* Ability to think strategically, work collaboratively across multidisciplinary and multicultural teams and deliver results under tight timelines with an ability to develop innovative approaches and solutions.

**WHO competencies required for the assignment:**

1. Teamwork

title: Trainer in Data Science
description:
**Reporting To:** General Manager - L&D

**About the Role**

EduSkills Foundation is looking to appoint an experienced and industry-oriented **Data Science Trainer** to deliver high-quality technical training to **M.Tech students**.

The trainer will be responsible for delivering structured classroom sessions, hands-on practical training, industry-oriented assignments, and capstone projects. The objective is to help students build strong foundations in data science while developing the practical skills required for research, higher studies, and industry careers.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Data Science Training**

Deliver comprehensive training covering:

* Python for Data Science
* Statistics & Probability for Data Science
* Data Analysis and Data Visualization
* NumPy and Pandas
* SQL & Database Fundamentals
* Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
* Machine Learning
* Supervised & Unsupervised Learning
* Feature Engineering
* Model Evaluation & Optimization
* Data Pre-processing
* Introduction to Deep Learning
* Natural Language Processing (NLP)
* Time Series Analysis
* Generative AI / LLM Fundamentals
* Responsible & Ethical AI

2. Hands-on Learning

The trainer will conduct practical sessions using tools and technologies such as:

* Python
* Jupyter Notebook / Google Colab
* Pandas
* NumPy
* Matplotlib / Seaborn
* Scikit-learn
* SQL
* TensorFlow / PyTorch
* Power BI / Tableau, where applicable
* Git/GitHub

3. Projects & Capstone Development

* Design and mentor **real-world Data Science projects**.
* Guide students in identifying problem statements and datasets.
* Support students in data collection, cleaning, analysis, modelling and evaluation.
* Mentor students in developing their M.Tech projects and capstone projects.
* Review project progress and provide technical feedback.
* Encourage students to work on research-oriented and industry-relevant use cases.

4. Assessments & Evaluation

* Prepare assignments, quizzes, coding exercises and practical assessments.
* Conduct periodic evaluations of student performance.
* Assess students based on both technical knowledge and practical implementation.
* Provide constructive feedback and identify areas requiring improvement.

5. Research & Industry Orientation

* Introduce students to current developments and emerging trends in Data Science and AI.
* Encourage research-oriented thinking and problem-solving.
* Discuss real-world industry use cases.
* Guide students on research papers, datasets, experimentation and technical documentation.
* Support students in developing portfolios, GitHub repositories and project presentations.

Required Technical Skills

The trainer should have strong practical knowledge of:

**Programming**

* Python

**Data Analysis**

* NumPy
* Pandas
* Data Cleaning
* Exploratory Data Analysis

**Databases**

* SQL
* Relational Databases

**Machine Learning**

* Scikit-learn
* Regression
* Classification
* Clustering
* Ensemble Methods
* Model Evaluation
* Feature Engineering

**Data Visualisation**

* Matplotlib
* Seaborn
* Power BI / Tableau – preferred

**Advanced Skills – Preferred**

* Deep Learning
* TensorFlow / PyTorch
* NLP
* Generative AI
* LLMs
* Computer Vision
* MLOps / Cloud Platforms

Educational Qualification

Preferred qualifications:

* M.Tech / M.E. / M.Sc. in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics or a related field

A Ph.D. or research experience will be an added advantage.

Experience

**Preferred:** 3+ years of relevant experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, Analytics, or technical training.

Candidates with strong industry experience and demonstrated expertise in Data Science may also be considered.

Prior experience in training **M.Tech / postgraduate students** will be an added advantage.

Trainer Expectations

The selected trainer should be:

* Strong in practical implementation
* Excellent in classroom communication
* Capable of explaining complex concepts in a simple manner
* Experienced in project mentoring
* Comfortable handling postgraduate-level students
* Industry-oriented and updated with current technologies
* Able to conduct coding and hands-on sessions
* Capable of delivering both theoretical and practical sessions
* Willing to mentor students beyond classroom delivery

Deliverables

The trainer will be expected to:

* Deliver the agreed Data Science curriculum.
* Conduct hands-on coding and laboratory sessions.
* Provide assignments and practical exercises.
* Conduct assessments.
* Mentor student projects.
* Track student learning progress.
* Provide feedback and performance reports.
* Support students in developing industry-ready portfolios.
* Participate in project reviews and presentations.
* Maintain training quality and agreed academic timelines.

The final engagement model, duration, training hours and remuneration will be mutually agreed based on the programme requirements and trainer experience.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: Manager, Statistical Programming
description:
Location: New Delhi, India
Category: Consulting
widget: Full time
 Posted Date: September 27th 2026

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!


**Job Details**
===============

**Job Summary:**


We are looking for an experienced Statistical Programmer with strong hands\-on expertise in SAS programming and deep knowledge of CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM. This role will be responsible for independently developing, validating, and maintaining SAS/R programs including development of analysis datasets and production of TFLs to support clinical studies and regulatory submission deliverables, with oversight and guidance responsibilities. It requires a deep understanding of clinical trial design and data analysis.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop and validate datasets in compliance with dataset specifications following CDISC standards (SDTM and ADaM) and study requirements.
* Program, generate, and quality check TFLs for efficacy and safety analyses for clinical study report or regulatory submissions following SAP, mock shells and internal standards.
* Perform SAS and R statistical programming.
* Contribute to the preparation and review of programming deliverables across multiple studies or projects.
* Collaborate closely with Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical, and other cross\-functional teams to resolve data issues and support study objectives.
* Support creation and maintenance of programming documentation, specifications, and standard processes.
* Contribute to process improvements, standardization efforts, and development of reusable programming tools such as macros and templates.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality programming outputs in a fast\-paced clinical development environment.
* Provide technical guidance and day\-to\-day support to junior programmers or peers as needed.
* Participate in code review, debugging, and validation activities to support quality and consistency across programming deliverables.
* Validating/debugging the codes written by other team members.
* Maintain quality and timeliness of project work.

title: Program Officer – Health AI & Digital Health
description:
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.  



  

**Program Officer – Health AI \& Digital Health**

**Location:** New Delhi  

**Organizational Base:** PATH  

**Role:** Embedded with the IndiaAI Mission, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

 **Project Background**

  

The Government of India is implementing the **IndiaAI Mission**, a national initiative to strengthen India's Artificial Intelligence ecosystem and accelerate the responsible development and adoption of AI for economic and social impact. The Mission is being implemented across seven pillars, including IndiaAI Compute, Foundation Models, AIKosh (IndiaAI Datasets Platform), IndiaAI Application Development, FutureSkills, Startup Financing, and Safe \& Trusted AI.

  

Healthcare is an emerging priority area under the IndiaAI Mission, with ongoing efforts to identify and develop AI solutions addressing healthcare and public health challenges. These efforts include partnerships with health\-sector institutions such as ICMR and initiatives to leverage AIKosh, AI infrastructure and the wider AI innovation ecosystem for healthcare applications.

  

IndiaAI is also expanding its engagement with Central Ministries, State Governments, regulatory bodies, technology companies, startups, academia, research institutions and implementation partners to enable sector\-specific AI deployment and integration with existing government digital platforms.

 **Position Summary**

  

PATH is seeking an experienced **Program Officer – Health AI \& Digital Health** to provide technical, programmatic and coordination support to the IndiaAI Mission on healthcare and public health priorities.

  

The position will be embedded with the IndiaAI Mission, MeitY, and will serve as a **health\-domain bridge between government, healthcare institutions and the AI/technology ecosystem**. The incumbent will support IndiaAI Mission leadership in identifying and prioritizing high\-impact health AI opportunities, assessing AI solutions, facilitating pilots and deployment, strengthening engagement with health\-sector stakeholders, and supporting pathways for validation, adoption and scale\-up.

  

The role will require a balance of **health\-domain expertise, technology understanding, program management, stakeholder engagement and execution capability**.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **1\. Strategic and Programmatic Support to IndiaAI Mission Leadership**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical and programmatic support on healthcare and public health applications of AI.
* Support identification and prioritization of strategic health\-sector opportunities
* Translate health\-system and public health priorities into actionable AI use cases, programs and potential partnerships.
* Prepare briefing notes, concept notes, presentations, strategic updates and decision\-support materials
* Track key developments in health AI, digital health, technology deployment and relevant government initiatives and provide actionable insights.
* Support planning and coordination of priority health AI initiatives

 **2\. Health AI Use\-Case Development, Assessment and Deployment**

* Support due diligence and technical assessment of AI solutions, startups, technology partners and proposals under consideration.
* Facilitate progression of suitable solutions from **use\-case identification and assessment through pilot, validation, deployment and scale\-up**.
* Support development of implementation and scale\-up models for AI solutions in government and public\-sector health settings.
* Work with domain experts, health institutions and technology partners to identify requirements related to workflows, infrastructure, human resources, capacity building
* Support integration of relevant AI applications with existing government digital platforms and health information systems.

 **3\. Health Data, AIKosh and Responsible Data Use**

* Identify and prioritize high\-value health datasets and data use cases that can support AI research, innovation and public\-sector applications.
* Engage with relevant stakeholders and other data\-holding entities to identify opportunities for responsible contribution and use of health datasets.
* Support assessment of health datasets for AI applications.
* Support initiatives for onboarding and effective utilization of relevant health datasets, models and other resources through AIKosh.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the health data ecosystem to support development, validation and deployment of AI solutions.

 **4\. Government and Ecosystem Engagement**

* Serve as a key health\-domain interface between IndiaAI/MeitY and health\-sector stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Central Government ministries and departments, State Governments other relevant stakeholders.
* Engage with AI startups, technology companies, academic institutions, research organizations, industry partners and development partners to identify relevant solutions and opportunities for collaboration.
* Support design and execution of consultations, workshops, roundtables, technical discussions, demonstrations and other stakeholder engagements.
* Build and maintain structured stakeholder and partnership pipelines for priority health AI opportunities.
* Support preparation and follow\-up of senior\-level meetings and engagements.

 **5\. Knowledge Management and Communication**

* Develop high\-quality technical briefs, presentations, concept notes, reports, case studies and other knowledge products.
* Prepare concise briefing and background materials for senior government officials and stakeholders.
* Document health AI use cases, deployment experiences, implementation learnings and emerging opportunities.
* Support dissemination of evidence, lessons and successful models across relevant stakeholders and forums.
* Represent PATH/IndiaAI engagements at relevant technical, policy and ecosystem forums, as required.

 **Expected Deliverables**

  

The incumbent will contribute to and/or lead delivery of:

  

* A prioritized **pipeline of health and public health AI use cases** aligned with IndiaAI priorities.
* Technical and implementation assessments of priority AI solutions and potential deployment pathways.
* Concept notes, implementation frameworks and roadmaps for selected health AI initiatives.
* Identification and prioritization of high\-value health datasets and opportunities for AIKosh.
* Technical inputs on responsible health AI, data governance, privacy, ethics and interoperability.
* Structured stakeholder and partnership engagement plans across government, technology, academia and health institutions.
* Periodic progress updates, dashboards, management briefs and decision\-support materials for IndiaAI Mission leadership.
* Policy briefs, technical notes, presentations and other knowledge products.
* Documentation of implementation learnings and recommendations for scale\-up.

 **Required Qualifications**

 **Education**

 **Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Allied Health Sciences, Paramedical Sciences, Public Health or another relevant health discipline**.

 **Preferred**

* Postgraduate qualification in Public Health, Health Administration, Health Informatics, Digital Health, Health Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related field.

 **Experience**

* **Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience**, with demonstrated experience in one or more of the following:
* Digital health
* Health technology implementation
* AI\-enabled healthcare solutions
* Health informatics
* Digital transformation of health systems
* Technology\-enabled public health programs
* AI/technology deployment in healthcare
* Demonstrated experience in **implementation, deployment, validation or scale\-up of digital health and/or AI\-enabled solutions** in real\-world healthcare or public\-sector settings.
* Experience translating healthcare or public health requirements into technology solutions, implementation plans or deployment models.
* Experience working with government health programs, ministries/departments, public health institutions, hospitals, medical colleges or large health systems.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or coordinating multi\-stakeholder programs involving government, technology partners, health institutions and/or development organizations.
* Strong experience in preparing technical documents, concept notes, presentations, analytical briefs and senior\-management communications.

 **Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of **healthcare and public health systems, service delivery and implementation realities**.
* Practical understanding of AI, digital technologies and their applications in healthcare; advanced software development expertise is not required.
* Ability to assess AI solutions from both **health\-domain and implementation perspectives**.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and structured\-thinking skills.
* Excellent program management and coordination capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and relationship\-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including ability to develop concise materials for senior government officials.
* Ability to translate complex health and technology concepts into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-level government environment and coordinate across multiple institutions and disciplines.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, responsiveness and ability to independently drive agreed actions to completion.
